name: Spoiled

text.trigger: A player spends food to raise an action die.
text.vignette: The label is peeling and the lid bulges just enough to be a rumour, but you are hungry in a way that makes doubt feel like a luxury. You take your thumb off the seal and think about it.

options.eat-it-anyway: Risk it: choose one of your survivors; they take 1 wound. The die rises as normal.
options.throw-it-away: Bin it: the food is still spent but the die does not rise.

notes: src: Crossroad_cards_v1.1.xlsx.txt card #5; Fires after the die was raised, so the spoiled option takes that raise back.
